entries.sourceText: Okay, this is a quick demo of multimodal live streaming in Gemini 2.0,
entries.targetText: እሺ፣ ይህ በGemini 2.0 የተለያዩ የመረጃ ዓይነቶችን በቀጥታ ማስተላለፍ አጭር ማሳያ ነው።

entries.sourceText: and we are casting a tab into AI studio.
entries.targetText: አንድ የአሳሽ ትር ወደ AI studio እያጋራን ነው።

entries.sourceText: [user] “Can you see my screen?”
[model] “Yes, I see your screen.
It's showing a document with the title ‘demo’.
entries.targetText: ‘demo’ የሚል ርዕስ ያለው ሰነድ እያሳየ ነው።

entries.sourceText: It also contains bullet points and a Google Meet window
entries.targetText: በነጥብ የተዘረዘሩ ሐሳቦችና የGoogle Meet መስኮትም አሉ።

entries.sourceText: with a person in the video. Is there anything in particular
entries.targetText: በቪዲዮው ውስጥ አንድ ሰው አለ። በተለይ

entries.sourceText: you would like to talk about on the screen?”
entries.targetText: በማያው ላይ ልታወራበት የምትፈልገው ነገር አለ?”

entries.sourceText: [user] “Yeah.
Can you start the demo by just reading the text
I highlighted?”
[model] “Sure, I can do that.
The text you highlighted reads ‘the Multimodal Live API lets you build
entries.targetText: ያደመቅከው ጽሑፍ እንዲህ ይላል፦ ‘Multimodal Live API

entries.sourceText: real time multimodal applications powered by Gemini 2.0 Flash.
entries.targetText: በGemini 2.0 Flash የሚሠሩ በቅጽበት የተለያዩ መረጃዎችን የሚያቀናጁ መተግበሪያዎችን እንድትገነባ ያስችላል።

entries.sourceText: It features tool use
like Google search and code execution, function calling, and more.’
entries.targetText: ለምሳሌ Google search፣ ኮድ ማስኬድ፣ function calling እና ሌሎችም።’

entries.sourceText: Would you like me to read the following lines too?”
[user] “No,
can you actually just tell me what this word means though?”
entries.targetText: ግን ይህ ቃል ምን ማለት እንደሆነ ልትነግረኝ ትችላለህ?”

entries.sourceText: [model] “I can do that.
Multimodal refers to the ability to process and understand
entries.targetText: Multimodal ማለት ማቀናበርና መረዳት መቻል ነው፣

entries.sourceText: different types of data like text, images, and audio altogether.
entries.targetText: እንደ ጽሑፍ፣ ምስልና ድምፅ ያሉ የተለያዩ መረጃዎችን በአንድነት።

entries.sourceText: Does that help?”
[user] “Yeah.
I need to demo the interruptions feature next.
Can you tell me a really boring kind of "once upon a time"
entries.targetText: በጣም አሰልቺ የሆነ፣ ‘ድሮ በአንድ ወቅት’ ብሎ የሚጀምር

entries.sourceText: sort of story?”
[model] “Okay, I can do that.
Once upon a time, in a small village nestled beside
entries.targetText: ድሮ በአንድ ወቅት፣ አንድ ትንሽ መንደር ነበረ፣

entries.sourceText: a quiet forest, there was a very unremarkable rock.
entries.targetText: ጸጥ ካለ ደን አጠገብ፤ እዚያም ምንም ልዩ ነገር የሌለው ድንጋይ ነበረ።

entries.sourceText: This rock was gray, and it was round,
and it sat there-”
[user] “Sorry, I have to interrupt you.”
[model] “No problem.
I understand that interruptions are part of the demo.
What should I do now?”
[user] “So we're going to demo memory.
Can you just summarize everything we've seen or heard so far?”
entries.targetText: እስካሁን ያየነውንና የሰማነውን ሁሉ ማጠቃለል ትችላለህ?”

entries.sourceText: [model] “I can do that.
So far, we've discussed a demo of the Multimodal Live API,
entries.targetText: እስካሁን ስለ Multimodal Live API ማሳያ ተነጋግረናል፣

entries.sourceText: which lets you build realtime multimodal apps.
entries.targetText: ይህም በቅጽበት ብዙ የግቤት ዓይነቶችን የሚያቀናጁ መተግበሪያዎችን እንድትገነባ ያስችላል።

entries.sourceText: And I defined what multimodal means.
I was also asked to tell a very boring "once upon a time" story,
entries.targetText: በጣም አሰልቺ የሆነ ‘ድሮ በአንድ ወቅት’ ታሪክ እንድነግር ተጠይቄ ነበር፣

entries.sourceText: but I was interrupted.
Is there anything else?”
[user] “No. I think we're done.
Do you want to read this ending card,
or should I?”
[model] “I can read it if you would like.
The ending card says, ‘start building with Gemini 2.0 at aistudio.google.com.’
entries.targetText: የመጨረሻው ካርድ፣ ‘በaistudio.google.com በGemini 2.0 መገንባት ጀምር’ ይላል።

entries.sourceText: Is that correct?”
[user] “Yeah. That's great.
All right, thanks, talk to you later.”
